message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a large, dark blue silhouette of a man’s head in left profile, centered against a background of concentric, wavy, gray and black bands resembling a deep open-pit mine. At the top, the white serif word "TEMPO" is prominent, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below it in smaller letters. Further up, white text reads "Film Pilihan Tempo 2022 H.62" and "Gula Makin Langka H.112" against a red and dark gray background.

Inside the dark head silhouette, bold yellow and white text reads: "PERANG TAMBANG PARA JENDERAL," followed by a paragraph starting with "Ferdy Sambo ditengarai mengintervensi..." and ending with "H.98." Three yellow construction excavators are positioned around the scene: one in the upper right on a gray ledge, one in the lower right, and one in the bottom left corner. At the bottom right, white text provides the date "19-25 DESEMBER 2022," the price "RP 50.000," and "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO," alongside a barcode and QR code.
